Designed for explosive topwater strikes, the Savage Gear 3D Snake delivers a unique surface presentation with its realistic snake profile, lifelike movement and irresistible side to side action.

Perfect for fishing shallow areas, around cover, or anywhere big pike are hunting for an easy meal. A struggling snake on the surface is a high value target, and when a predator commits, the result can be absolutely brutal. 🐊🔥

Slow it down, let it pause, and watch the surface come alive. The 3D Snake is built to trigger aggressive pike attacks when nothing else works.

snippet.title: Vietnam's Giant Bamboo Buildings Explained
snippet.description:
What looks like fragile bamboo can actually support massive architectural structures. Skilled craftsmen carefully select mature bamboo, treat it to improve durability, bend it into shape using specialized molds, and assemble enormous curved beams into stunning dome-shaped designs. A final protective coating helps the structure withstand moisture, sunlight, and years of outdoor exposure. This is a remarkable example of traditional craftsmanship combined with smart engineering.

نموذج مصغر بالحجم الطبيعي لمدينة طوكيو. خزان مياه ضخم من أربعة طوابق. لقطة واحدة، عشرات الكاميرات، وموجة أعلى من برج طوكيو المصغر.

صوّر فريق العمل المشهد بأكمله من ممر مرتفع فوق الخزان - الكاميرات الوحيدة الموجودة على مستوى الماء كانت تلك التي كانوا على استعداد للتضحية بها.

شاهد ما يحدث لجسر قوس قزح عند الدقيقة 0:07.
